characters: Folder characters, 22 sprites, all flexible. People and land creatures are seen from the front and slightly above, standing on the bottom row. Sea creatures are seen from straight above and face right, because the game rotates them to their heading.
nature: Folder nature, 18 sprites. All flexible except the lava tile. Draw leaves with the four foliage colours from the table above, so each sea can recolour them (green in the tropics, grey-green in the north, brown in the volcanic south). Trees stand with the base of the trunk at the bottom centre; they are about twice the captain's height.
buildings: Folder buildings, 21 sprites. Buildings show their front wall and roof, with the bottom of the wall on the bottom row. Doors are about 8 px tall so the captain fits through them. Draw roofs and plaster walls in the swap colours so towns can vary them.

The game assembles town forts and the player's Coastal Fort (45 to 77 px wide) from these pieces, so the stone, battlements and outline must match across all of them and the tiling edges must line up exactly.
The ten buildings a player can put on an island they own. The Coastal Fort is built from the fort pieces above, so it has no file of its own.
props: Folder props, 15 sprites, all flexible. Crates, barrels and the bottle also float at sea as loot, so they should read on blue water as well as on sand. The wreck is seen from straight above.
ship: Folder ship, 27 sprites, all fixed size. Ships are built on a grid of 5 × 5 px deck cells and seen from straight above, bow up. Each part's bottom 5 × 5 sits on one deck cell. Parts taller than 5 px stick out above the cell toward the bow (the rudder is the exception: it sticks out below, past the stern). Guns are drawn pointing up; the game turns them to face out over the side.
sails: Folder sails, 21 sprites, all fixed size, all seen from straight above. A sail's wooden yard (the pole it hangs from) is its bottom row, and the cloth bellies upward because the wind pushes it forward. Use only the sail cloth colours for the cloth, since every ship recolours its sails. Each sail comes full, half-reefed and furled (rolled up on its yard).
icons: Folder icons, 80 sprites, all fixed at 8 × 8 px. The inventory shows them at double size. One object per icon, centred and filling most of the square, at a slight angle from above. Keep the same outline and lighting across the whole set so the hold looks consistent.
effects: Folder effects, 8 sprites, all fixed size. These are tiny, so keep them to a few bright pixels with a clear shape.
